topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey there, I just heard about your transfer. It's a big change, isn't it? I know the new department is different, maybe a bit daunting, but it’s also got its own rhythm and its own cool people. It's a fresh start, a chance to learn and grow in ways you might not have expected. I’m really excited for you, even though I’ll miss having you around as much. Let’s catch up soon, maybe get a coffee and talk about everything. I’m here if you need to vent or just bounce ideas around. You’re going to do great, I know it!
